text:
maria: FYI discovered today: CLI, Node SDK, and sample app disagree on credential lookup order. New users end up hitting project permission errors after rotating keys.

sam: can you share the exact flows you saw?

maria: repro: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_key; export REDWOOD_PROJECT=team-x; create project-scoped key in Console and `rw auth rotate` locally. Node app starts using project key immediately, CLI keeps using the org key until new shell. sample-app priority is creds file > env so it never picks up env rotation.

ben: ah that explains support tickets. We documented "set REDWOOD_API_KEY" but never spelled out precedence.

lin: we had an ac decision a while back that SDKs should prefer env then file then metadata, and CLI should prefer explicit CLI-config then env then file. that mismatch is bitey.

sam: right. I think aligning to env -> file -> metadata across runtime/SDK/CLI would be least surprise. CLI can still persist `last-used` but shouldn't override env in current shell.

maria: agreed. Also error messaging is poor: 401/403 responses don't indicate which credential was attempted. newbies rotate keys blindly.

ben: proposal: add `REDWOOD_DEBUG_AUTH=1` which prints lookup order and resolved key id (masking full key) to stdout/stderr. Also change CLI to respect env precedence and drop auto-override of env during rotate unless `--set` is specified.

lin: add test matrix: combinations of (env set/unset) x (credentials file present/absent) x (cli-config present/absent) to prevent regressions. Put them in CI docker runner so OS shells aren't a factor.

sam: I can prototype in a small PR: implement precedence change in CLI, add debug logs, and clear `~/.redwood/last-used` on successful rotate. I'll link a changelog note.

maria: I'll update sample-app README to explain scoping: when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set we prefer project-scoped keys; show how to run `rw auth use --project` to bind.

ben: file an issue for improving error payloads from auth service to include attempted-key-id and scope mismatch info (careful about leaking).

devex-bot: Reminder: changes to credential resolution are breaking for some workflows. Add migration note and opt-in feature flag if needed.

maria: timeline: sam opens PR today, tests and docs follow. ben will draft support KB. lin will add test fixtures. Thanks! :thumbsup:
